The online tutorial that Yuriko shares with the group is focused on **music theory**. This topic is relevant to the group's interests as they are all involved in creating and improving their music skills, whether it be for jam sessions, individual practice, or professional development as musicians. The tutorial is expected to help them develop a deeper understanding of music theory, which can, in turn, enhance their musical performances and songwriting capabilities.

> - **Purpose:**
>   - To educate and empower group members with advanced musical concepts, improving their overall sound.
> - **Accessibility:**
>   - Conveniently delivered for members to access at their convenience.
> - **Application:**
>   - Becomes a resource for the group to incorporate into their practice sessions, potentially leading to more sophisticated arrangements and playing styles.
> - **Feedback:**
>   - Actively encouraged post-learning, allowing group members to share their thoughts and apply new insights to their collaborative efforts.

The group members, including LiHua, WolfgangSchulz, and ChaeSong-hwa, have expressed a proactive engagement with the tutorial, displaying enthusiasm for learning and integrating new ideas into their music sessions. This unity in pursuit of technical improvement highlights a shared commitment to evolving their craft and supporting one another through shared knowledge resources.

> **ChaeSong-hwa's Invitation:**

> - ChaeSong-hwa especially anticipates that the collaborative synthesis of the new theory insights will lead to creative music-making.

> **Overall group sentiment:**
> - There's a collective excitement surrounding the incorporation of the music theory tutorial, anticipating a transformation in their musical endeavors and joint creative outputs.
> - This reflects the group's philosophy of continual learning and mutual support in their pursuit of excellence in their musical journey.

> **Anticipation for Sunday Jam Sessions:**

> - The group exhibits enthusiasm for experimenting with new musical arrangements and tools during their time together.

In conclusion, Yuriko's music theory tutorial serves as an instrumental resource for intellectual and creative stimulation within the collective, steering the group towards a higher plane of musical performance and collaboration. The group’s collaborative dynamic fosters a supportive environment where members motivate each other, sharing new insights that culminate in the collective pursuit of musical growth.

> **Next Group Milestone:**
> - The next scheduled gathering includes sharing feedback on the tutorial's effectiveness and working on a new, unique arrangement of "Stand By Me," showcasing the creative integration of their study and group harmony.
